name: Web Search
description: Find information on the web. The plugin can use different providers. The default provider is Brave.

tool.name: WebSearch
tool.description:
Find information on the web. Use this tool when the user tells you to find facts that are possibly newer than your data. Use it for a new release, a new event or a URL. Use it to make sure that a fact is correct before you give it. Do not use it when this session or a file that you read has the result. When `Grep` or `Read` can find the result faster on the local disk, use that tool first.

The tool gives the found pages in the sequence of the provider. Each page has a title, a URL, a short part of its text, its date and its source. The tool tries a request again 2 times after some errors. Thus do not send the same request again immediately.

query.description: The words to find. You must give this value. The maximum is 400 characters. Most providers give better results for 2 to 6 important words than for full sentences.

type.description:
The type of result. The values are:
- `web`: general pages.
- `news`: new items about events.

count.description: The number of pages to give. The default is 10. A small number is usually better. Usually only the first 5 pages are important.

offset.description: The page number of the results, from 0. Use it to get the pages after the first page.

freshness.description: A time filter. The values are `pd` (the last day), `pw` (the last week), `pm` (the last month) and `py` (the last year). For a range of dates, write `YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD`.

country.description: The country of the results, as an ISO code of 2 letters, or `ALL`. For example, `US` or `DE`.

lang.description: The language of the results, as a code of 2 letters. For example, `en` or `de`.

safesearch.description: The filter for content that is not safe for children.

format.description:
The result format. The default is `text`.
- `text`: short lines for a person to read.
- `json`: a data structure with the same fields. Use it when you must get specified values from the result.
